changes.title: Audio shed
items: If your computer can't keep up with the sound, the game now drops the quieter extras (ambience, then thick synth voices, then long echoes) so the music keeps playing
Add ?audio=lite to the address to start with the light sound, or ?audio=full to keep everything

changes.title: Hunt in area
items: An area's animals fight you while you're in their area, and lose interest and go home once you leave it, as before

changes.title: Population b10
items: The first few areas round home are a little gentler, and the far ones a little tougher
